decisions.H271_does_not_replicate: not established - the automated verdict is withdrawn

limits: BATCHIE has about 23 compounds per layout and gene annotation covers 131 of 209 compounds.
The residual arena is not the same target as GDSC's synergy call, so only the relative contrast is comparable.
Retrospective; no mechanism, clinical or drug-choice claim; no meta-learning or RSI.

why_invalid.symptom_1: identity and identity+gene give hit rates identical to four decimal places (difference exactly 0.0000 with a zero-width CI), which cannot happen if the gene block had any effect
why_invalid.symptom_2: both sit at 13.59% while the base rate for a bottom-quartile target is 25%, i.e. far BELOW chance, meaning the ranking is systematically inverted relative to the target
why_invalid.symptom_3: the random block scores 27.81%, about chance, and beats both real arms, which is the opposite of what a capacity control should show
why_invalid.technical_cause: the lean rewrite of the additive null uses an in-sample fit for the training residual and an out-of-sample fit for the held-out residual, so the two residual scales differ; combined with a 4,889-dimension gene block solved at a fixed alpha, the predictions are not comparable, and the ranking becomes anti-correlated with the target
why_invalid.consequence: this run cannot be used as evidence for or against the cross-dataset claim

promotion_status.cross_dataset_check: unresolved - BATCHIE is hard because the raw arena saturates (R86) and the residual arena is hard to fit (this round)
promotion_status.note: the earlier dose-aware run (R88/R89) did work with RidgeCV and a smaller gene set; this round's rewrite broke comparability
